execution_policy.authority_rule: Current Founder sovereignty and CONSTITUTION autonomy level remain authoritative. Mission Control becoming canonical operational control plane requires explicit reconciliation and Founder-ratified amendment where constitutional text is affected.
execution_policy.lease_rule: Before any remote repository mutation acquire income-os.repo-write plus company-os.<task_id>; BUSY/corrupt/token mismatch fails closed.
